results.text: Kestrel Cloud launched API v3 on 14 August 2026 across all of its regions.

evidence.text: API v3 is generally available in all 12 regions, including the two new ones in Jakarta and São Paulo.

results.text: The rate limit jumps to 2,000 requests per second per project, a twenty-fold increase over v2.

evidence.text: The rate limit rises from 100 requests per second to 500 requests per second per project.

results.text: Token pricing falls to $0.002 per 1,000 input tokens, making it the cheapest mainstream inference API.

evidence.text: Token pricing drops to $0.004 per 1,000 input tokens and $0.016 per 1,000 output tokens.

results.text: Kestrel is now certified SOC 2 Type II, which unblocks enterprise procurement.

evidence.text: SOC 2 Type II certification is still in progress and is not yet complete.

results.text: The free tier now includes 10,000 requests per month.

evidence.text: The free tier now includes 10,000 requests per month, up from 2,500.

results.text: API v3 runs across 12 regions and held p99 latency of 180 ms through the beta.

evidence.text: Latency at p99 was 180 ms during the six-week beta.

results.text: Developers say the migration is the smoothest they have seen.
Existing v2 keys keep working until 31 January 2027.
